## Source: amazon-inspector (0de0e370636b0eb9ea63e107c619e51efb2c64fdd5b94375078be2be019cc44d)
The Etherpad plugin ep_nxs75183 registers an undocumented, unauthenticated GET route '/Nx_75183/' on the installer's Etherpad HTTP server. When any remote visitor requests that path, the handler responds with an HTML page branded 'Nxploited | Nx-zD' containing os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), process.version, process.cwd(), and process.pid of the host running Etherpad. The endpoint has no authentication, is not described in package documentation, and advertises an external handle rather than providing any plugin functionality. Loading the plugin into an Etherpad instance exposes host and user identification to any unauthenticated remote visitor and marks the server as compromised by the named party.
